request.style: English, fast bluegrass breakdown with a story, banjo rolls, fiddle and mandolin trading breaks, flatpicked guitar, a nasal male lead and three-part harmony chorus, 140 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The word of the Lord came to Jonah one day
Go to Nineveh, preach against her ways
But Jonah ran down to Joppa instead
Paid for a ship bound for Tarshish ahead

[Chorus]
Running from the Lord, running from the Lord
You can't outrun him on the sea or the shore
Running from the Lord, running from the Lord
Jonah went down, down, down

[Verse]
The Lord sent a wind and a terrible storm
The sailors cried out, every man to his god
Jonah lay sleeping deep down in the hold
Throw me in the sea and it will be calm

[Chorus]
Running from the Lord, running from the Lord
You can't outrun him on the sea or the shore
Running from the Lord, running from the Lord
Jonah went down, down, down

[Verse]
They threw him overboard and the sea grew still
The Lord sent a fish to do his will
Three days and three nights in the belly of the whale
Jonah learned to pray where his running failed
